overall.label: CRITICAL
overall.rating_text: RED — Severe issues detected that may cause business impact
overall.decisive_alert: HANA-HDB: Severe issues for log backup/recovery operations; plus a critical HANA HotNews (SAP Note 3794443) for the current revision

system_facts: SAP S/4HANA 2021 FPS02 (On-Premise)  |  SAP Kernel 793 PL400
SAP HANA 2.0 SPS08 Rev 089.03 (upgraded 11.10.2026; was Rev 082.00)
SUSE Linux Enterprise Server 15 SP7 on HANA host (was SP3); app servers SLES 15 (x86_64)
top_actions: 1. Fix the recurring HANA log backup irregularity (81 vs ~769/day on 15.10, 1 failure on 17.10 — same Thu-low / Sat-failure pattern as Sept) and review HotNews 3794443 (partitioning duplicates) — SAP Notes 1642148, 3794443
2. HANA DATA volume is now 82.2% used (17.8% free, was 80.5%) — approve Azure disk expansion and run housekeeping (ARFCSDATA, BALDAT, APQD, SOFFCONT1 growth)
3. Reduce SAP_ALL (8 users, was 10), debug/replace (6, was 7) and broad table access (93) in client 800; define HANA audit policies in SYSTEMDB
4. S/4HANA 2021 mainstream maintenance ends 31.12.2026 (~2.4 months from report end) — management decision on upgrade roadmap/budget; SAPUI5 1.96 and Fiori FES 2021 end the same day
5. Triage 411 ABAP dumps (down from 486) — UNCAUGHT_EXCEPTION (169), TSV_TNEW_PAGE_ALLOC_FAILED (59), RAISE_SHORTDUMP (39) are the top causes
6. Work the interface backlog: 117,554 bgRFC inbound errors (59,113 backlog), 5,886 tRFC errors, 7,958 stale SMQ3 queues, failed/unprocessed EWM PPF actions

action_items.finding: Irregular HANA log backup pattern + 1 failure
action_items.technical: 15.10.2026: only 81 successful log backups vs. 769/day on 16-18.10; 1 unsuccessful log backup on 17.10.2026 (2,388 successful / 1 failed in the window). HANA alert 65 (log backup runtime) fired 2,819x at priority 3. Same signature as the Sept report (79 on Thu 10.09, 1 failure on Sat 12.09): low count on the first Thursday and a failure on Saturday. Still the decisive red alert.
action_items.impact: Recovery Point Objective at risk; a recurring pattern increases the data-loss window if a failure coincides with a disaster.
action_items.recommendation: Compare Thursday/Saturday schedules (backup tool/Backint, housekeeping, maintenance windows); check the small local catalog/log backup volume (28.5 GB, 24.8% free); validate Backint health; alert on log backup failures via DBACOCKPIT; SAP Notes 1642148, 2081845.

action_items.finding: NEW: HANA HotNews 3794443 applies to the current revision 2.00.089.03
action_items.technical: EWA HANA-HDB check "SAP HANA Critical Revisions" is RED. SAP Note 3794443: Standard Table Partitioning can introduce duplicate records or table inconsistencies. EWA parameter check also expects indexserver.ini [partitioning] mvcc_data_max_rows_per_chunk = 4294967295 (currently not set).
action_items.impact: Potential duplicate records / inconsistent partitioned tables; second decisive red alert this cycle. Partitioned tables stay exposed until mitigated.
action_items.recommendation: Read SAP Note 3794443 and apply its mitigation (parameter and/or revision) in a controlled change; then check partitioned tables for duplicates per the note.

action_items.finding: Data backup frequency/operation not optimal
action_items.technical: Only 1 data backup per day recorded (15-18.10.2026, all successful); rated non-optimal by the EWA algorithm (yellow).
action_items.impact: Longer recovery time if a data backup is missed; increased reliance on log replay.
action_items.recommendation: Confirm daily full data backup completes successfully; review DBACOCKPIT backup catalog and scheduling.

action_items.finding: Indexserver memory usage close to effective allocation limit
action_items.technical: Indexserver 688 GB of 956 GB effective allocation limit (72.0%, was 72.3%); tables 527 GB (Row 73 + Column 454) = 54.2% of the 973 GB global limit (guideline <50%). EWA observed a memory bottleneck in the previous week (heap peak 17.10.2026 18:00, RoDict 172.8 GB, LOB pages 64.3 GB).
action_items.impact: Risk of table unloads or Out-of-Memory dumps impacting performance/availability if consumption keeps climbing.
action_items.recommendation: Analyze top memory consumers (SAP Note 1999997); consider unloading/archiving unused column-store tables; review HANA sizing vs. current workload.

action_items.finding: No customer-defined HANA audit policies enabled (HDB-SYSTEMDB)
action_items.technical: 0 custom audit policies in SYSTEMDB (EWA yellow). Note: the HDB tenant itself shows 33 activated audit policies and is rated green.
action_items.impact: Inability to detect or forensically investigate unauthorized system-level (SYSTEMDB) access.
action_items.recommendation: Define audit policies for privileged operations (DATA ADMIN, user/role changes) per HANA Security Guide; watch CS_AUDIT_LOG_ growth.

action_items.finding: 8 users hold SAP_ALL in production client 800 (improved from 10)
action_items.technical: Client 800: 8 of 1,589 valid users (was 10 of 1,458). Client 000: 9 of 15 valid users (was 10 of 15). EWA rating RED for both.
action_items.impact: Unrestricted access to all transactions/data — major segregation-of-duties and audit risk.
action_items.recommendation: Review each remaining SAP_ALL assignment; replace with role-based access; limit to emergency-access (firefighter) process only.

action_items.finding: 6 users authorized to Debug/Replace in production (client 800) (improved from 7)
action_items.technical: S_DEVELOP ACTVT=02, OBJTYPE=DEBUG assigned to 6 production users (was 7); 1 user in client 000.
action_items.impact: Debug-and-replace bypasses ABAP authorization checks and can alter data in-flight.
action_items.recommendation: Restrict debug-replace to a controlled, logged emergency-access role; remove from standard production roles.

action_items.finding: 93 users can display/change all tables via SE16/SM30 (client 800)
action_items.technical: S_TABU_DIS with ACTVT 02/03 and DICBERCLS=* assigned to 93 of 1,589 users (unchanged vs. Sept: 93); 1 user in client 000. EWA rating RED.
action_items.impact: High risk of unauthorized viewing or modification of sensitive business/config data.
action_items.recommendation: Restrict table-maintenance authorizations to specific authorization groups per role; review SUIM usage before revoking.

action_items.finding: Mainstream maintenance for SAP S/4HANA 2021 ends 31.12.2026
action_items.technical: EWA rated RED — maintenance expires in about 2.4 months from the report end (74 days; was ~3.5 months in Sept).
action_items.impact: Loss of SAP standard support and Security Notes coverage after expiry; compliance exposure.
action_items.recommendation: Escalate to management immediately; finalize the upgrade project timeline/budget for a supported S/4HANA release.

action_items.finding: Support Package level outside SAP Security Note coverage window
action_items.technical: S4CORE/SAP_ABA/SAP_BASIS/SAP_GWFND last imported 22.04.2023 (43 months ago, was 41); final assembly dates 50-56 months old. S4CORE 106 is on SP02 vs. latest SP10 (8 SPs behind).
action_items.impact: System is not guaranteed High/Very-High priority Security Notes — elevated vulnerability exposure, and the gap keeps growing.
action_items.recommendation: Schedule a Support Package Stack upgrade for S4CORE 106 (SP02 → latest) — ideally as part of the S/4HANA upgrade project.

action_items.finding: SAPUI5 1.96 patch 25 and Fiori FES 2021 reach end of maintenance 31.12.2026
action_items.technical: SAPUI5 1.96 patch level 25 is past End of Cloud Provisioning (31.12.2024); EoM 31.12.2026 is ~2.4 months away. SAP Fiori FES 2021 for S/4HANA (SAP_UI 756) also ends 31.12.2026.
action_items.impact: Bug fixes and security patches for the UI layer are no longer guaranteed.
action_items.recommendation: Apply the latest SAPUI5 1.96 patch via Maintenance Planner (SAP Note 2217489) and plan the front-end server upgrade with the S/4HANA roadmap.

action_items.finding: DATA volume at 82.2% utilization (above 80%)
action_items.technical: exmp-hdb-p1 DATA: 1,343.43 GB total, 1,103.68 GB used, 239.75 GB free (17.8% free; was 19.5%). Used data grew 22.7 GB in 5 weeks (~20 GB/month); at that rate the 90% line (~1,209 GB) is ~5 months away. EWA DB-size growth metric is higher (+41.27 GB/month).
action_items.impact: Above SAP's 80% capacity guideline; the database suspends if the data volume fills.
action_items.recommendation: Plan Azure disk expansion now; housekeeping on ARFCSDATA/BALDAT/APQD; review SOFFCONT1 (LOB, 239.9 GB) retention.

action_items.finding: System replication connection closed (3x, priority 4)
action_items.technical: Alert ID 78 — connection between primary (SITE1 exmp-hdb-p1) and a secondary (SITE2 SYNC / SITE3 exmp-hdb-q3 ASYNC) closed 3 times (was 1).
action_items.impact: Secondary may stop receiving replicated data, risking an RPO gap and weakening failover readiness.
action_items.recommendation: Investigate network/replication interruptions; confirm both replication targets are ACTIVE and in sync.

action_items.finding: 411 ABAP dumps recorded (12-19.10.2026) — down from 486
action_items.technical: Top contributors: UNCAUGHT_EXCEPTION (169), TSV_TNEW_PAGE_ALLOC_FAILED (59), RAISE_SHORTDUMP (39), SESSIONMEM_QUOTA_WARNING (27), RAISE_EXCEPTION (20), SAPSQL_DATA_LOSS (18), CALL_FUNCTION_SEND_ERROR (15). Daily peak 96 on 13.10. SYSTEM_SHM_AREA_DETACHED fell from 37 to 1.
action_items.impact: Still ~8x the <50 guideline; may cause failed background jobs and end-user errors.
action_items.recommendation: Triage top dump types via ST22; root-cause UNCAUGHT_EXCEPTION and memory dumps; raise SAP incidents where code-level issues are found.

action_items.finding: qRFC outbound queues in CPICERR/SYSFAIL status
action_items.technical: 12 queues (34 entries) in error: 2 CPICERR (RFC connection open) and 10 SYSFAIL (name/password incorrect). Oldest from 27.07.2023 (PRABCCLNT800...), others 2024-2025 — unresolved for 3+ years.
action_items.impact: Interfaces (deliveries, WMQFV/WMQFC) not processing — potential lost or delayed business transactions.
action_items.recommendation: Correct RFC destination credentials/connectivity per SAP Note 378903; reprocess or clear stale queues; daily SMQ1 monitoring.

action_items.finding: qRFC unprocessed outbound queues in READY status since 2023
action_items.technical: 29 queues (158 entries) listed in READY status, mostly PRABCCLNT800... first entry 27.07.2023.
action_items.impact: Stale, unresolved outbound queue entries indicate long-standing unresolved interface issues.
action_items.recommendation: Analyze root cause per queue with business/interface owners; clear or reprocess after correction.

action_items.finding: qRFC inbound queues in SYSFAIL status
action_items.technical: 25 queues (76 entries) listed; errors include user locked, serial-number/status mismatches, quantity mismatch, "warehouse request exists". Entries span 2020-2026 and new ones were added 13-16.10.2026.
action_items.impact: Inbound EWM/delivery confirmations failing to post — potential inventory/financial discrepancies.
action_items.recommendation: Work with business teams to fix master data/authorization causes; reprocess via SMQ2.

action_items.finding: NEW: large bgRFC, tRFC, IDoc and batch-input error volumes (cross-application BPA)
action_items.technical: bgRFC inbound: 117,554 errors / 59,113 backlog; tRFC outbound: 5,886 errors and backlog; inbound IDocs in error: 3,464; batch input sessions: 947 in error, 1,129 in backlog; workflows in error: 135. All rated RED/YELLOW by EWA.
action_items.impact: Silent processing backlog across interfaces; potential lost or delayed documents and growing tRFC/bgRFC tables (ARFCSDATA).
action_items.recommendation: Analyze via SBGRFCMON, SM58, WE02/BD87, SM35 and SWI2_FREQ; identify top failing destinations/message types; reprocess or purge per business sign-off.

action_items.finding: 7,958 EWM queues older than 365 days saved in SMQ3
action_items.technical: Oldest entries date back to 2020; count up from 7,839 in Sept.
action_items.impact: Long-term unresolved queue backlog consumes DB space and obscures genuinely new issues.
action_items.recommendation: Evaluate business relevance per SAP Note 2558561; restore relevant queues to SMQ2 and reprocess, delete irrelevant ones.

action_items.finding: Unprocessed PPF actions older than 2 weeks (ZX_DELIVERYNOTE)
action_items.technical: 50 /SCDL/DELIVERY PPF actions with status 0 (not processed) listed, created 20.08-01.10.2026 (profile /SCWM/FDO_01).
action_items.impact: Delivery note output/communication may not be reaching customers/carriers on time.
action_items.recommendation: Review via SPPFP; clear stuck 'Processes at' selections; deactivate unused action definitions per Note 1423066.

action_items.finding: Failed PPF actions older than 2 weeks (status 2 — error) — EWA rating RED
action_items.technical: 50 failed actions listed (20.08-02.10.2026): ZSCWM/REPACK_HU_PRINT 17, ZPRINT_HU_PARTIAL_UD 15, ZHU_LABEL_AUTO 6, ZPRINT_PICK_HU_STO_OUT 4, Z_AUTO_GR_INB 3, ZPRINT_PICK_HU 3, ZSCWM/MSG_PRD_SEND 2.
action_items.impact: Warehouse label/print and messaging processes silently failing — potential operational disruption on the warehouse floor.
action_items.recommendation: Analyze error logs via SPPFP per action profile; correct root cause (print server/config) and reprocess.

action_items.finding: EWM system 8 support packages behind latest SP
action_items.technical: S4CORE 106 installed SP02; latest available SP10.
action_items.impact: Missing bug fixes and side-effect corrections relevant to warehouse operations.
action_items.recommendation: Plan an EWM/S4CORE support package upgrade in the next maintenance window (SAP Note 432027).

action_items.finding: Missing SAP Notes for delivery / warehouse-order inconsistencies
action_items.technical: 6 delivery notes not downloaded (3300534, 3311529, 3321269, 3157937, 3153491, 3233459) plus 1 warehouse-order note 3558727 (enqueue-lock loss / update termination) and 1 missing side-effect note 3249535.
action_items.impact: Increases risk of document-flow and warehouse-order inconsistencies going undetected.
action_items.recommendation: Download and implement via SNOTE, prioritizing those affecting active business processes (note: SP02 of S4CORE 106 does not include them).

action_items.finding: Period integrity inconsistency in table MSKA (client 800)
action_items.technical: Fiscal Year/Period fields (LFGJA/LFMON) at initial value '0000/00' for at least one MSKA record — unresolved since last period.
action_items.impact: Can cause migration/posting errors and inaccurate stock valuation reporting.
action_items.recommendation: Run report MMIM_S4SIC_CHECKS (Note 3268840, prereq 3212869) to identify and correct affected records.

action_items.finding: Number range RK_BELEG (CO Document) at 81.14% used
action_items.technical: 18,863,400 numbers remaining of 100,000,000; ~356,700/week (was 395,600) — non-rolling; was 79.30% in Sept. Linear estimate: 95% warning level in ~39 weeks (mid-2027), exhaustion in ~53 weeks.
action_items.impact: If exhausted, CO document postings fail with hard errors, halting controlling processes.
action_items.recommendation: Monitor via SNRO; plan interval extension well before the 95% warning threshold.

action_items.finding: 157 overtaker/bypassed transport requests in the last week
action_items.technical: Sequence errors where an older object version overwrote a newer one; 160 in Sept. Total production transports in the week: 10 (0 import errors, 0 created in production).
action_items.impact: Risk of regressions being silently reintroduced into production.
action_items.recommendation: Review transport sequencing practices with development teams; audit flagged sequence errors for actual impact.

action_items.finding: Large tables requiring reorganization: ARFCSDATA (48.4 GB), BALDAT (39.3 GB), APQD (13.1 GB)
action_items.technical: Flagged by the EWA table-reorg check; ARFCSDATA was 46.8 GB and BALDAT 36.3 GB in Sept; APQD (batch input queue data, 23.7M records) is newly listed.
action_items.impact: Continued uncontrolled growth increases backup time, memory footprint and log volume pressure.
action_items.recommendation: Housekeeping per SAP Notes 375566 (ARFCSDATA), 195157 (BALDAT), 36781/18307 (APQD — clean up old batch input sessions).

action_items.finding: SOFFCONT1 (content repository LOB) grew 31.6 GB since Sept
action_items.technical: SOFFCONT1 disk size 239.9 GB (was 208.3 GB) — roughly two thirds of the +48.8 GB total DB-size increase between the two analyses (910.97 → 959.80 GB). SRMCONT_MN (66.8 GB disk) and REPOLOAD (33.3 GB) are also large.
action_items.impact: Main driver of DATA volume growth; accelerates the disk-capacity risk.
action_items.recommendation: Review office/attachment retention and archiving; check what is writing to SOFFCONT1 (SAPoffice/send-to-user, attachments).

action_items.finding: Add-on SAP ECTR 1.1 for S/4HANA past end of mainstream maintenance
action_items.technical: EWA add-on table: SAP ECTR 1.1 FOR SAP S/4HANA — mainstream maintenance ended 31.12.2025 (rated RED); SAP Fiori FES 2021 and SAP Fiori for S/4HANA 2021 end 31.12.2026 (yellow).
action_items.impact: No SAP fixes for the add-on; blocks a clean S/4HANA upgrade path if not addressed.
action_items.recommendation: Confirm ECTR usage and plan its upgrade/replacement (Engineering Control Center) within the upgrade roadmap.

action_items.finding: Delta merge failures (52x, priority 3) — improved from 91x
action_items.technical: Alert ID 88 — M_DELTA_MERGE_STATISTICS shows failed delta merges on column-store tables; 52 occurrences (Sept: 91).
action_items.impact: Degraded read performance and increased memory pressure from unmerged delta storage.
action_items.recommendation: Review delta merge failures in the Indexserver trace; investigate affected tables; manual merge if automatic merge keeps failing.

action_items.finding: Admission control queueing (2x, priority 4) — improved from 4x
action_items.technical: M_ADMISSION_CONTROL_EVENTS: QUEUE events on 13-16.10 with max wait up to 12.15 s (e.g. 187 requests on 15.10 02:00).
action_items.impact: Possible periodic contention/performance bottlenecks under peak load.
action_items.recommendation: Investigate hours with the highest queueing for CPU-intensive requests; review parallel_merge_threads (workload parameter flagged).

action_items.finding: Deadlocks detected (9x, priority 3)
action_items.technical: Alert ID 149 — transactions automatically rolled back; 9 occurrences (7 in Sept, 3 before). Also 3 ABAP DBSQL_SQL_DEADLOCK_DETECTED dumps.
action_items.impact: Possible contention under peak load; failed postings may need rework.
action_items.recommendation: Review deadlock traces (Note 1858357) for recurring patterns; correlate with the ABAP dumps.

action_items.finding: Trusted certificates expiring soon (7x, priority 3)
action_items.technical: HANA alert ID 129 — certificates nearing/at expiry in the trust store.
action_items.impact: Certificate expiry can break system replication or secure internal communication unexpectedly.
action_items.recommendation: Identify and renew expiring certificates; cross-reference with the EXMP certificate tracker.

action_items.finding: Technical user password expiry (alert 62, 7x in SYSTEMDB) and SLD data supplier (alert 135, 175x)
action_items.technical: SYSTEMDB alerts: ID 62 (7x, priority 3) and ID 135 — SAP HANA SLD Data Supplier configuration (175x, priority 3, new). Alert 62 is no longer raised for the HDB tenant.
action_items.impact: Password expiry on technical users can lock accounts and halt interfaces; SLD supplier gap only affects landscape reporting.
action_items.recommendation: Disable password lifetime for confirmed technical users (Note 2082406); configure or disable the SLD data supplier as documented.

action_items.finding: Only lightweight/statistics-server consistency check scheduled; 45,406 tables not verified
action_items.technical: No full CHECK_TABLE_CONSISTENCY run recorded; 0 table-level checks; statistics server checks ran 9 hours before the report.
action_items.impact: Undetected data corruption could persist unnoticed — relevant given HotNews 3794443.
action_items.recommendation: Schedule a full/global consistency check in a low-load window per SAP Note 2116157.

action_items.finding: NEW: 28 HANA parameters not set as recommended (+ 1 workload parameter)
action_items.technical: Parameter check yellow for HDB and SYSTEMDB: e.g. tcp_backlog, gc_unused_memory_threshold_abs/rel, min_segment_size, suspended_cursor_lifetime (720 vs 1,440-14,400), smart_merge_decision_func; workload: parallel_merge_threads 0 (recommended 5-10).
action_items.impact: Sub-optimal memory management and merge behaviour after the 2.00.089 upgrade; some defaults should be restored.
action_items.recommendation: Review the list against Note 2600030, restore defaults where recommended and set recommended values in a change window.

action_items.finding: Service data quality gap — hardware utilization data missing
action_items.technical: exmp-hdb-p1 shows no performance data and exmp-app-abc shows OS not detected; hardware capacity checks run only on exmp-app-p3/p4 (CPU max 19% / 13%).
action_items.impact: Some EWA hardware capacity checks cannot run, reducing report accuracy.
action_items.recommendation: Verify SAPOSCOL/collector configuration on the affected hosts per SAP Note 1309499; re-check next EWA cycle.

action_items.finding: NEW: default passwords of standard users and TMSADM in a client other than 000
action_items.technical: EWA yellow: standard users have default passwords; alert "TMSADM exists in another client than 000".
action_items.impact: Well-known credentials on standard users are an easy entry point.
action_items.recommendation: Run RSUSR003; change SAP*, SAPCPIC, TMSADM passwords (Notes 1749142, 1414256); remove TMSADM outside client 000.

action_items.finding: NEW: obsolete/deprecated applications in use
action_items.technical: EWA RED: 9 obsolete/deprecated apps in use — VD03 (obsolete, 49 uses L1M), LSMW (deprecated, 3,493), SM19/SM20 (37 each), MK03 (505), F2030 (26,482), /AIF/IFMON, UKM_BP, UKM_MALUS_DSP — plus 8 apps with successors or future obsolescence (e.g. F1708 64,111 uses, F3719 My Queries 2.8M uses).
action_items.impact: Usage must be remediated before or during the S/4HANA upgrade; deprecated tools are not maintained.
action_items.recommendation: Map each app to its successor (BP, RSAU_CONFIG/RSAU_ADMIN, F3473, ...) and include in upgrade scope and training.

action_items.finding: NEW: Silent Data Migration — new rows added after migration finished
action_items.technical: Client 800: CL_CO_ESH_LONGTEXT_MAPPING_V2 (PP-SFC) 270 new rows; CL_SDM_QM_STXH (QM) 1 new row in 4 entries. Initial-status SDM classes: none.
action_items.impact: Unmigrated data in old data model can cause unpredictable business-process results.
action_items.recommendation: Find the writer (custom code/load tools), re-trigger SDMI per SAP Note 2907976 section 30 and KBA 3445802; check SDM_MON.

action_items.finding: NEW: SAP Notes solving side effects missing (PP/PM, FI&AC, EWM)
action_items.technical: PP/PM: 12 solving notes missing (5 High, 5 Medium, 2 Low; e.g. 3383084, 3380326, 3331313, 3299444, 3317377); FI&AC: 3 distinct notes (3224196, 3282474, 3718597); EWM: 3249535. All "not downloaded — SP2 of S4CORE 106 does not include this Note".
action_items.impact: Known side effects of already implemented notes (MRP/MD01N, asset BCF, intercompany reconciliation) remain unfixed.
action_items.recommendation: Implement via SNOTE after test; the SP stack upgrade resolves most of them.

action_items.finding: NEW: tiny leftover quantities (<0.001) in 7 storage bins
action_items.technical: Warehouses VNS1 (6 bins) and MYS1 (1 bin); shown as 0.000 in the UI but block put-away because bins are not considered empty.
action_items.impact: Put-away on affected bins can be blocked.
action_items.recommendation: Remove via the EWM Check Monitor per SAP Note 3138922 (/SCMW/CHM_LOG → Rounding Residual Quantity).

action_items.finding: Elevated business document backlog across O2C / P2P / Finance / PP
action_items.technical: Notable: 71,774 blocked vendor invoice items, 35,149 failed cost postings, 252,072 production orders without deletion flag, 4,549 overdue customer payments, 3,228 overdue outbound deliveries — values identical to the Sept report (BPA collection every 3 months, data date 12.10.2026).
action_items.impact: Backlogs can mask process/master-data issues and affect working capital, on-time delivery and closing efficiency.
action_items.recommendation: Share findings with the respective process owners (FI, SD, MM, PP) for root-cause triage.

action_items.finding: EWM recommended background jobs not scheduled (12 jobs)
action_items.technical: e.g. /LIME/COLLECTION_DELETE, /SCWM/R_REORG_HU_WO_PRINT, /SCWM/PI_PERS_PPF_DEL, RSPPF_SWJCLEAN, RBDMANI2 — unchanged.
action_items.impact: Gradual accumulation of obsolete EWM data impacting performance over time.
action_items.recommendation: Schedule the missing recommended housekeeping jobs per the EWM Operations Guide (Note 3418083).

action_items.finding: No archiving set up for 23 recommended EWM objects
action_items.technical: 0% of recommended EWM archiving objects configured (DLV_INB, DLV_OUT, WME_HU, WME_TO, ...) — unchanged.
action_items.impact: Long-term database growth and potential future performance degradation.
action_items.recommendation: Define and pilot archiving for high-volume EWM objects, starting with a residence-time review in SPRO.

action_items.finding: NEW: gateway errors, unscheduled periodic jobs and unused ICF services
action_items.technical: Gateway error log 1,118-2,579 errors/day (top: /IWFND/CM_CONSUMER 101 PAGE_BUILDER_CUST 7,581x); jobs /UI2/PERS_EXPIRED_DELETE and /UIF/CLEAN_LREP not scheduled; 1,404 activated ICF services unusable (EWA: 25.4% usable); Design Studio apps in use.
action_items.impact: Noise hides real errors; unused active ICF services are a security exposure; unscheduled cleanup jobs allow table growth.
action_items.recommendation: Analyze /IWFND/ERROR_LOG (Note 3013836); schedule the two jobs; deactivate unused ICF services (KBA 3261151); replace Design Studio apps (Note 3081996).

action_items.finding: NEW: long-running custom programs and enterprise-search daemon
action_items.technical: ZPP_UPDATE_STARTEND (HTTPS) 541 steps at 119.5 s avg; RFC PDATE_STARTEND_ZMTS_UPLOAD_DATES 334 s avg; batch ESH_EX_FU_DEMON = 10.3% of batch response time and 17.8% of batch DB time. Overall performance rated green (avg dialog 387 ms).
action_items.impact: Not user-visible today but heavy resource consumers that add to HANA memory/CPU load.
action_items.recommendation: Review SQL/ABAP of the custom programs (ST05/SAT); review ESH index schedule and scope.

action_items.finding: Residual number range trace records (client 800)
action_items.technical: Orphaned trace records for RF_BELEG (SG12) and RV_BELEG, small volumes (remark 3) — recurring, unchanged.
action_items.impact: Minimal performance impact but unmanaged technical debt.
action_items.recommendation: Confirm traces are inactive; delete residual records via NK_DISPLAY_TRACE / NK_SET_SYSLOG_PARMS.

action_items.finding: NEW: deprecated HANA repository API used
action_items.technical: Component REPOSITORY / API used 2 times (last 19.10.2026 01:22) — typical for HANA Studio or report RDDHANAD.
action_items.impact: Deprecated feature; will break with future HANA versions.
action_items.recommendation: Administer via SAP HANA Cockpit (Note 2800006); see Note 2425002.

action_items.finding: SAP Solution Manager mainstream maintenance ends 2027; migration to SAP Cloud ALM recommended
action_items.technical: EWA data still routed via Solution Manager 7.2 (ST-PI 740/35); EWA recommends direct transfer and completing the Cloud ALM transition before 2028 — unchanged guidance.
action_items.impact: No immediate risk, but a multi-year transition needs early planning.
action_items.recommendation: Run SAP Readiness Check for Cloud ALM; build a transition roadmap over 12-18 months; plan direct EWA transfer by Q3 2027 (Notes 207223, 3612479).

risk_areas.Critical: HANA backup irregularity + HotNews 3794443, HANA memory pressure, security exposure (SAP_ALL / debug / audit), maintenance expiry
risk_areas.High: HANA DATA volume >80%, ABAP dumps, EWM queues/PPF backlog, RFC/bgRFC failures, number range, replication, transport sequencing, housekeeping
risk_areas.Medium: HANA stability alerts, consistency checks, patch/side-effect notes, SDM new rows, obsolete apps, data quality, business process backlog

conclusion: Critical Action Required — RED EarlyWatch Alert Report. The SAP S/4HANA production system ABC (Example Customer / EXMP landscape) remains in CRITICAL health (illustrative score 46/100, was 43) based on the EWA report for 12–18 Oct 2026. Two red alerts decide the rating: SAP HANA (HDB) log backups are irregular again (81 vs. ~769/day on 15 Oct, one failure on 17 Oct — the same Thursday/Saturday pattern as September) and a new HANA HotNews (SAP Note 3794443, table partitioning duplicates) applies to the freshly upgraded revision 2.00.089.03. Eight production users still hold SAP_ALL and six hold debug/replace rights in Client 800 (down from 10 and 7), and 93 keep broad table access. HANA DATA volume has crossed 80% (82.2% used; DB growth 41.3 GB/month, driven mainly by SOFFCONT1), and the Support Package stack is 43 months behind, with S/4HANA 2021, SAPUI5 1.96 and Fiori FES 2021 all leaving mainstream maintenance on 31 December 2026 — under 2.5 months away — so the upgrade roadmap needs a management decision now. On the positive side, the kernel (793), HANA (2.00.089.03) and SLES 15 SP7 uplift is complete, ABAP dumps fell to 411 (from 486), and availability stayed at 100%.
